scope: Compare the historically working Proxima ChatGPT image path with the current failing D:\OAUTH ChatGPT image adapter across browser/session ownership, transport, prompt submission, completion detection, original-byte acquisition and durable local save.

browser_session_ownership.proxima: Owns a dedicated persistent ChatGPT browser partition/session and long-lived BrowserView; the image-ui path runs inside that authenticated page context.
browser_session_ownership.oauth: Does not own or launch the required ChatGPT browser/profile. It assumes an external Playwright CDP browser at a hard-coded 127.0.0.1:9222 endpoint, attaches to the first context and opens a temporary page.
browser_session_ownership.finding: The currently evidenced OAUTH failure occurs before generation because the assumed external CDP endpoint is unavailable. Browser/profile ownership is therefore missing from the adapter contract.

transport_class.proxima: BROWSER_CDP-equivalent browser automation for the proven image-ui lane; legacy private-backend code also exists but is not the reusable target.
transport_class.oauth: HYBRID: raw httpx private-backend attempt first, then external browser-CDP fetch fallback.

prompt_submission.proxima: Proven image-ui lane finds a ready visible composer, fills the prompt and activates the send control in the authenticated page.
prompt_submission.oauth: Builds a guessed /backend-api/conversation payload and posts it through httpx or in-page fetch; current wire-protocol document itself marks exact payload fields as hypothesis/live-capture pending.
prompt_submission.finding: For the bounded image proof, UI composer semantics are the evidenced reusable behavior. Guessed private-backend request fields are not required for FA-W004 and should not be the foundation.

auth_and_requirements_chain.proxima: The proven image-ui lane relies on the already-authenticated browser page rather than reconstructing the private backend auth chain.
auth_and_requirements_chain.oauth: HTTP code treats a stored session-token value as a Bearer token; CDP POST path relies on cookies and does not establish the documented /api/auth/session accessToken plus chat-requirements chain before private-backend conversation submission.
auth_and_requirements_chain.finding: D:\OAUTH documentation separately records that the web backend Bearer is the accessToken from /api/auth/session and that the private backend requirements chain differs from the adapter's current assumptions. Fixing port 9222 alone therefore does not establish a proven private-backend image path.

completion_detection.proxima: Image-ui establishes a pre-submit image baseline, watches for a new sufficiently large image in a new turn, waits for a stable candidate and generation-stop disappearance, then fails closed on timeout.
completion_detection.oauth: Private-backend path parses SSE for guessed asset pointers/URLs and otherwise waits a fixed 30 seconds before one conversation re-fetch; it does not use the proven UI image lifecycle for the image proof.

original_byte_acquisition.proxima: The proven image-ui path fetches the selected generated image from inside the authenticated browser context and passes bounded raster bytes to a durable exporter.
original_byte_acquisition.oauth: Attempts file-id download via CDP/httpx or direct URL download. When URL download fails it can return URL-only ImageData instead of durable original bytes.
original_byte_acquisition.finding: FA-W001 explicitly forbids URL-only success. The FA-W004 implementation must fail closed unless original bytes are actually acquired.

durable_save_and_validation.proxima: Content-addressed SHA-256 filename, raster magic detection for PNG/JPEG/WebP, bounded size, atomic write, dedupe by content hash and JSON receipt.
durable_save_and_validation.oauth: Writes random chatgpt_<uuid>.png filenames directly, assumes .png extension, has no atomic content-addressed write, no magic-versus-extension enforcement and no receipt-level dedupe/lineage in ChatGPTImageAdapter._save_asset.
durable_save_and_validation.finding: The durable exporter behavior should be independently reimplemented under the FA-W001 contract rather than copied from Proxima.

failure_semantics.proxima: Image-ui fails when composer/send/image capture/original-byte materialization fails; durable artifact is required by the autonomy proof.
failure_semantics.oauth: Has typed AuthError/RateLimitError in parts of the flow but conflates CDP unavailability with authentication at the API boundary and permits URL fallback after failed byte download.

exact_reusable_boundary.name: WINDOWS_CHATGPT_BROWSER_IMAGE_PROOF_BOUNDARY_V1
components: Dedicated headed browser/profile owner with explicit one-principal lifecycle and no hard-coded dependency on an unowned CDP process.
Authenticated page-state detector that returns READY, AUTH_REQUIRED or BLOCKED without reading/exporting cookies or tokens.
Composer reacquisition plus visible prompt submission through the browser UI for the bounded image proof.
Pre-submit image inventory plus bounded new-image completion detector with timeout and fail-closed behavior.
Original-byte fetch through the same authenticated browser context or a browser download event; screenshot, preview and URL-only outputs fail.
Format/magic detection, positive dimensions/bytes, decode-reopen and SHA-256 validation under FA-W001.
Atomic content-addressed local persistence plus receipt; packaging or preview files do not mint new semantic assets.
Typed terminal states for browser unavailable, auth required, blocked/protection challenge, composer unavailable, generation timeout, download failure and invalid bytes.
explicitly_not_reused: private-backend reverse-engineering as the required image transport

licensing_and_policy_boundary.policy_observation: Current canonical MUXIA policy blocks autonomous consumer-web output extraction and holds unattended programmatic prompt dispatch pending a supported interface or policy clarification. FA-W003 is analysis only and does not itself authorize FA-W004 execution.

recommended_next_engineering_change.approach: Replace the current ChatGPT image proof path with the independently implemented browser-owned UI boundary above. Do not patch only CDP port 9222 and do not promote the current guessed private-backend flow as proven.
recommended_next_engineering_change.minimum_acceptance: One bounded authorized prompt produces provider-generated original bytes, durable local save, reopen/decode, MIME/magic, dimensions, bytes and SHA-256 with no URL-only or screenshot-only fallback.
